description: A/B benchmark: deltapv-master vs driftjax v0.1.18 on identical device structures and AM1.5G spectrum. Both use the same venv, CPU x64, and jax 0.10.2.

ex1.description: PN junction: Si, 200nm n+ / 200nm p-, 500 points

multi_optimization.description: SLSQP on 2-param subspace (mp, Eg), 50 iterations, FD vs adjoint gradient

notes: Jsc matches EXACTLY between both codes → drift-diffusion solver parity confirmed
PCE < 1% relative difference → numerical accuracy preserved
Voc discrepancy: deltapv uses last sweep voltage (vmax) as proxy; driftjax uses bracketed root-finding
driftjax uses native banded GE solver + XLA compilation cache; deltapv uses scipy LAPACK
driftjax IFT adjoint gradient is 2.2x faster than 4-point finite differences
Both codes use identical thermal voltage/current scaling (kT/q = 0.02585 V, J0_scale = 1.096 MA/m^2)

Row equilibration (v0.1.18b): per-scalar-row diagonal scaling from block entries tames ~25M:1 row-scaling imbalance in SRV/contact regions without leaving XLA. Solution-preserving (D·J·x = D·b ⟺ J·x = b). No measurable speed penalty (negligible O(N) overhead vs O(N·bw²) GE).
